# External Development References

Recommended:

```bash
git submodule add https://github.com/ComputationalPsychiatry/hgf-toolbox external/hgf-toolbox
```

Then checkout and pin the exact reference commit.

Optionally add PyHGF as a development reference submodule as well, or pin it as a Python dependency.

Do not rely on a moving `main` branch during migration.
